description: This PHP script handles saving a project template in the SuiteCRM system. It initializes a new 'AM_ProjectTemplates' bean, populates it from POST data, saves it, and redirects to a GanttChart view of the template.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving Bean objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the Bean object to the database.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates a Bean object with data from POST request.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirecting after the save operation.
